name: HOPE: Unlived Life
source:
How to get out of a dull life? How to overcome your fear and become happy? HOPE: Unlived Life is a story about growing up, finding yourself and lost love in the scenery of Russian reality.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2413580/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
如何摆脱平淡的生活？如何克服恐惧并变得快乐？《HOPE: Unlived Life》是一个关于在俄罗斯现实风景中成长、寻找自我和失去爱情的故事。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2413580/]Steam[/url]]
